title: STILL-PRESENT: W3 byte-identity claim — types.odin amendment extends the false pre-4.2 promise instead of retracting it
detail: The r2 claim "all three texts amended" fails for types.odin: the sentence now lists 4.2 among streams that "stay byte-identical" — the exact falsehood W3 flagged. serialize.odin states the opposite. The amendment broadened the false claim instead of correcting it.
recommended_fix: Reword to match serialize.odin: pre-4.2 streams are byte-identical except Packet_Dropped, whose payload gains the shed-bundle byte (re-blessed, cause-documented).
